<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('p','W','g') and n['id']>=11:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        print(n['id'], n['color'], 'px', n['pixels'], 'bbox', min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols))
res = action(['UP'])
prev = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); cur = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diffs = [(r,c,prev[r][c],cur[r][c]) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if prev[r][c]!=cur[r][c]]
print('UP ndiff', len(diffs))
# summarize diff bbox
if diffs:
    rs=[d[0] for d in diffs]; cs=[d[1] for d in diffs]
    print('diff bbox', min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    print(diffs[:20])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
